walkthrough:
In circle of radius $r$ with angle $\angle AOB = 2\theta$, calculate chord $AB$ and arc length $AB$:
$$\text{Chord } AB = 2r\sin\theta$$
$$\text{Arc } AB = r(2\theta) = 2r\theta$$

Identify the sides of the rectangle $ABCD$ ($AD = BC = r$ and $CD = AB = 2r\sin\theta$):
$$\text{Perimeter} = AD + CD + BC + \text{Arc } AB = r + 2r\sin\theta + r + 2r\theta = 2r + 2r\theta + 2r\sin\theta$$

Calculate the area of rectangle $ABCD$ with $r = 5$ and $\theta = \frac{\pi}{6}$:
$$AB = 2(5)\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right) = 10\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) = 5\text{ cm}$$
$$\text{Area}(ABCD) = AD \times AB = 5 \times 5 = 25\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of circular sector $AOB$ (radius $5$, central angle $2\theta = \frac{\pi}{3}$):
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } AOB) = \frac{1}{2}(5^2)\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \frac{25\pi}{6}\text{ cm}^2 \quad (\approx 13.08997)$$

Calculate the area of triangle $\triangle AOB$:
$$\text{Area}(\triangle AOB) = \frac{1}{2}(5^2)\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = \frac{25\sqrt{3}}{4}\text{ cm}^2 \quad (\approx 10.82532)$$

Calculate the shaded area by subtracting the circular segment from the rectangle:
$$\text{Area}(\text{segment } AB) = \frac{25\pi}{6} - \frac{25\sqrt{3}}{4} \approx 2.26465\text{ cm}^2$$
$$\text{Shaded Area} = 25 - \left(\frac{25\pi}{6} - \frac{25\sqrt{3}}{4}\right) \approx 25 - 2.26465 = 22.735 \approx 22.7\text{ cm}^2 \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$
